en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river, with supporting concrete piers. On the right bank stands a multi‑story tower-like building on a wooded hill, with a flag on top. In the foreground, foliage and the river are visible. At the bottom, there is printed Dutch text identifying the scene as the new Waal bridge with the Belvédère in Nijmegen.
